targetRule: Complete edited file text only, followed by EOS; no wrapper or explanation.

scoring.exactMatch: UTF-8 text equality after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; preserve all other whitespace.
scoring.preservation: Frozen replacement prefix and suffix must remain unchanged; no semantic equivalence claim.
scoring.unnecessaryEdits: Boolean: output fails to preserve the frozen prefix or suffix. Extra content inside the replacement region fails exact correctness.
scoring.syntaxCheckability: Record per-language syntax check status when a later evaluator provides a cheap checker; exact fixture targets are known-valid.
